The retriever uses the Dense Passage Retriever (DPR) bi‑encoder.  
It encodes the query \(x\) into a vector \(q(x)\) and each document \(z\) into a vector \(d(z)\) with BERT‑based encoders.  
Retrieval is performed by finding the top‑\(k\) documents with the highest inner product \(d(z)^{\top}q(x)\), i.e., a **Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS)**.  
MIPS can be solved approximately in sub‑linear time, allowing efficient retrieval from the document index.  

[rag‑knowledge‑intensive‑nlp.pdf — Page 3]
